title: detect_missing_values: scan all columns for missing values and return a summary table
description: Inspect every column in the dataset for null or missing values. Returns a table with columns [column, missing_count, missing_pct, dtype], sorted by missing_pct descending, showing only columns that have at least one missing value. If no missing values exist, returns a single informational row. Does not modify the dataset.
rag_note: Takes no parameters. Scans all columns and returns only those with missing_count > 0, sorted by missing_pct descending. Returns a single row '(no missing values)' when the dataset is complete. Use before fill_missing_values or remove_missing_values to understand which columns are affected.
